jobsBoardCase.overview: With the Jobs Board, I built a complete application, from the frontend and database to deployment. I taught myself the stack I needed along the way.
features: Applying for jobs with a CV and cover letter
Background jobs that run independently of the request

stack.name: Next.js, React, TypeScript
stack.role: User interface and server logic in one project

architecture: The backend runs entirely through Next.js: server code and interface live in the same project, with no separate Node.js server.
I work with Docker locally, and the production database is hosted on Neon.
challenges: Problems connecting Inngest to Docker. I checked and adjusted the configuration.
The database schema did not match the current code. I added the missing columns using Drizzle and updated the Neon database.
Problems deploying to Vercel. I checked the logs and looked for the causes.
Job listings initially supported locations only in the USA. I updated the code and database to support other countries as well.
learned: Next.js and TypeScript: I learned how to use React with Next.js and integrate server-side logic into a web application.
Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui: I learned how to style user interfaces and use ready-made components.
React Hook Form and Zod: I learned how to build forms and validate user input.
Drizzle ORM and Neon: I learned how a database works, how to store data, and how to make changes to the database schema.
Clerk: I learned how to add user authentication and account management to an application.
Inngest and Resend: I learned how to run background tasks and send emails.
UploadThing and Google Gemini API: I learned how to upload files and use AI to summarize resumes.
Docker and Vercel: I learned how to set up the development environment and deploy an application online.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a web developer with a bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering. In the past I worked with PHP, Laravel, OpenCart, WordPress and MySQL, including a role as a web developer in 2018–2019. From 2022 to 2024 I worked as a freelance front-end developer with React.
about.p2: After that, I learned German (B1 certificate, currently taking a B2 course) and built my own projects this year. With the Jobs Board, I created a full application using Next.js, Drizzle and Clerk, teaching myself the modern stack along the way. I'm looking for a role in web development.
